top_signals.title: Market Repricing Fed Expectations, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
top_signals.summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the systematic alternative ETF at BlackRock, reacts to the Federal Reserve's decision to raise interest rates by 25 basis points. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Foreign Holdings of US Treasuries Fell to Nine-Month Low in July
top_signals.summary: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fell in July to the lowest level since October, led by declines in the stockpiles of France and Canada.
